name: ANDROLAB
category: Men's health supplements and clinic programmes

definition.summary: ANDROLAB is SuamiSihat's men's health science brand. ANDROLAB Alpha is a daily sachet supplement; ANDROLAB RX is the label used for doctor-led programmes delivered through SS Clinic.

facts.label: Audience
facts.value: Men 30+ who want an evidence-led approach to vitality

facts.label: Pack languages
facts.value: Bahasa Melayu and English sachet versions

range.name: ANDROLAB Alpha
range.desc: Daily botanical sachet. Prototype artwork P0104 in BM and English.

range.name: ANDROLAB RX
range.desc: Doctor-supervised programme name used inside SS Clinic. Not advertised to the public as a medicine.

definition.claimsReview: Earlier copy named a prescription medicine (tadalafil) under ANDROLAB RX. Prescription medicines cannot be advertised to the public in Malaysia; keep RX content internal to clinic materials.

positioning.statement: For men who want vitality explained, not hyped, ANDROLAB pairs clinic know-how with clear, well-labelled formulations.

pillars.title: Science, explained
pillars.text: Ingredients and how to take them, in plain words.

pillars.title: Clinic-connected
pillars.text: Backed by SuamiSihat's clinic network for advice and follow-up.

pillars.title: Precise design
pillars.text: Carbon, electric blue and a single gold RX mark: lab-like and calm.

avoid: Naming prescription medicines in public material

colors.name: Science Blue
colors.use: Rules, icons, large headings on Carbon

colors.name: Science Blue Text
colors.use: Blue text and buttons on light

accent.role: RX Gold for the RX mark and one highlight

colorScheme.note: Science Blue #0A89FA is for Carbon backgrounds; on light surfaces use #0A6BC4.

pattern.name: Molecular Lattice
pattern.description: Linked nodes in Science Blue with a single RX Gold atom on Midnight Carbon.
usage: Use on Carbon backgrounds behind hero areas

guideline.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark on every side. Nothing (text, edges, other logos) enters this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Digital 110 px wide; print 28 mm wide
do: Use the master lockup on Carbon or Clinical Surface
Show Alpha and RX as sub-brands under ANDROLAB
Keep RX Gold to the RX mark
dont: Do not use RX materials in public advertising
Do not set the logo in RX Gold
Do not add effects or outlines

typography.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold for headlines and key numbers; Montserrat for subtitles and labels
typography.body: Helvetica Neue for print body copy; Inter on the web; Calibri in Office documents
typography.note: Typefaces follow Brand System section 04. Never retype a wordmark; always place the supplied logo file.
